verdict.rationale: VPM's own registered-agent service receives service of process, legal notices and state correspondence, scans them the same day, and sends real-time email alerts, which prioritizes legal and state mail routed through that channel. There is no evidence that ordinary mailbox mail such as IRS letters is automatically flagged or prioritized; generic automation rules and tagging exist but are not documented as doing this. Missing for 10: automatic flagging or priority handling of government/IRS mail arriving in the regular mailbox, deadline-aware alerts, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
